title: Jubilant Crisp Egyptian Creme Patissiere Fritters
description: A low-fat Egyptian dessert featuring creme patissiere, with a crispy exterior and a soft interior, perfect for a hangover cure, infused with herbal flavors.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, and baking powder.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sugar, eggs, milk, vanilla extract, crushed mint leaves, and salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a piping bag or a spoon, drop the batter into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
To make the creme patissiere, whisk together the milk, sugar, and eggs in a medium saucepan.
Cook the creme patissiere over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens and coats the back of a spoon.
Fill the fritters with the creme patissiere and serve warm.
